questions.q: What problem does the Composite API primarily solve?
options: It lets several REST sub-requests, including ones that reference each other's results, run as a single HTTP call
It replaces SOQL entirely with a new query language
It compresses JSON payloads to reduce bandwidth
It converts REST requests into SOAP requests automatically
questions.explain: Composite API bundles multiple sub-requests, which can reference each other's results via referenceId, into one HTTP round trip.

questions.q: In a Composite request, how does a later sub-request reference an ID generated by an earlier sub-request in the same call?
options: By polling a separate endpoint for the new ID
It cannot reference an earlier sub-request's result
Using the @{referenceId.field} syntax, e.g. @{NewAccount.id}
By re-querying the record with SOQL before continuing
questions.explain: Composite resolves @{referenceId.field} references against the results of earlier sub-requests in the same call, in order.

questions.q: What does the GraphQL API let a client do that a single plain REST call typically cannot?
options: Bypass authentication entirely
Delete records without specifying an ID
Skip API versioning
Request an exact, often deeply nested data shape (e.g. an Account with its related Contacts) in one round trip
questions.explain: GraphQL lets the client describe precisely the nested shape of data it wants, returning exactly that shape in one query.

questions.q: What distinguishes the Streaming API family from REST, SOAP, and Bulk?
options: It only works with the Partner WSDL
It is push-based: the client subscribes once and receives real-time notifications, rather than pulling by repeatedly asking
It does not require authentication
It can only be used for SOAP-style operations
questions.explain: Streaming API (PushTopics, Platform Events, CDC) is built on a publish-subscribe model where the server pushes events to subscribers, unlike the pull model of REST/SOAP/Bulk.

questions.q: Which Streaming API form would you subscribe to specifically to be notified whenever any Account record is created, updated, deleted, or undeleted?
options: Change Data Capture (CDC), via a channel like /data/AccountChangeEvent
A custom Platform Event
The Bulk API 2.0 ingest job
The GraphQL API
questions.explain: Change Data Capture provides per-object channels that notify subscribers of create/update/delete/undelete events for that object.
